13: std::vector<size_t> empty_target_matches(size_t source_size) {
14:     std::vector<size_t> matches;
15:     matches.reserve(source_size + 1);
16: 
17:     for (size_t index = 0; index <= source_size; ++index) {
18:         matches.push_back(index);

20:

24: AlgoResult make_result(std::string_view name,
25:     std::vector<size_t> matches, size_t compare_count, Clock::time_point begin) {
26:     return AlgoResult{
27:         .name = std::string{name},
28:         .match_count = matches.size(),
29:         .compare_count = compare_count,
30:         .use_time_ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(Clock::now() - begin).count(),
31:     };
32: }

34: }  // namespace

36: AlgoResult brute_force(std::string_view source, std::string_view target) {
37:     const auto begin = Clock::now();
38:     size_t compare_count = 0;
39: 
40:     if (target.empty()) {
41:         return make_result(__func__, empty_target_matches(source.size()), compare_count, begin);
42:     }
43: 
44:     std::vector<size_t> matches;
45:     if (target.size() > source.size()) {
46:         return make_result(__func__, std::move(matches), compare_count, begin);
47:     }
